response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS value FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

assumptions.assumption: Only media types with at least one track over the byte threshold are included in the outer average; media types with no qualifying tracks are excluded.
Per-media-type average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios (not total bytes divided by total milliseconds), using real division to avoid integer truncation.

alternatives.interpretation: Per-media-type value computed as ratio of sums (SUM(Bytes)/SUM(Milliseconds)) rather than mean of per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(r) AS value FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS r FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x
